In this role, you will own the product strategy and roadmap for DAM capabilities, such as asset ingestion and metadata, search and discovery, rights and usage management, content reuse, and multichannel distribution. You will work closely with Engineering, UX, and customers to identify high-impact problems, define requirements, and ship solutions that balance ease of use with the rigor demanded by a highly regulated industry.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager - Medical Content - Ostro
jobs.description_text: The Role Veeva-Ostro builds the AI-powered engagement platform behind some of pharma's most innovative brand experiences — conversational virtual navigators, personalized content journeys, and omnichannel tools that give patients and HCPs real-time, accurate answers. As a Senior Program Manager on our Implementation/Professional Services team, you'll own the end-to-end quality of every deliverable, from client-facing designs and content matrices through PRC submission to pre-launch QA of the live tool, while developing the processes and leading the team of contractor editors who bring each build to life. It's a chance to bring deep pharma marketing editorial expertise into a fast-moving SaaS/tech environment at the center of how the industry is reinventing patient and HCP engagement.

Das sagt dir dein zukünftiger Manager: Wenn es unseren Kundinnen gut geht, geht es auch uns gut. Sie sind das Wichtigste, was wir haben, und genau so behandeln wir sie auch. You will work directly with partners and customers, as well as with Auterion’s core platform, hardware and flight test teams. Between trips, you will work from our Munich office, both at your desk and on the bench. No drone experience is required. If you have integrated software on cars, robots, industrial machines or other embedded systems, you already have the right foundation, and we will teach you the drone side. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – with support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, npm, Python, and Bazel.
